money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local currency is the Belarus Ruble (BYN). If you’re travelling to Belarus, its important you speak to your Australian bank before you go. Because of sanctions against Belarus, your bank may block your card if you use it in Belarus. Not all international cards are accepted or can be used in Belarus. Many reputable international money transfer providers have suspended operations in Belarus. It can be difficult to exchange Australian dollars for Belarusian rubles. consular.notes: Australia doesn't have an embassy in Belarus. Contact the Australian Embassy in Russia for consular help. Our ability to provide consular assistance is severely limited. The Australian Government will not be able to evacuate you from Belarus.

laws.rule: Penalties for drug offences are severe. They include long prison sentences.

laws.rule: Always carry your passport, original visa, and migration card. Authorities can ask for ID at any time. They can detain you if you don't have identification. Copies of ID aren't accepted. Belarus has the death penalty for crimes including murder and 'attempted terrorism'. Belarus imposes jail sentences for 'terrorism propaganda', 'discrediting' the Belarusian government, security forces and military organisations and extended the death penalty to include 'high treason'. The Belarusian Government may require males it considers Belarusian 'reserve officers' to undertake military service up to the age of 27, regardless of any other nationality you may hold.
